title: ci: build.yml fails on every push (missing root .nvmrc)
description: build.yml (Dec 2024) runs setup-node with node-version-file .nvmrc and npm ci at the repo root. The JS code moved to js/ (pnpm workspace) and there is no root .nvmrc, so lint and test fail at setup-node on every push, e.g. alpha 7787604 run 39712582683. CI currently gates nothing.
acceptance_criteria: CI installs and runs lint/test for the js/ pnpm workspace (and the Python package if intended) under a pinned runtime; green on alpha.
notes: Owner decision needed before fixing: build.yml's publish job runs 'npx lerna publish' on push to alpha/beta/main once lint+test pass, with NPM_TOKEN. Making CI green turns every alpha merge into an npm prerelease. There is no lerna.json in the repo, and the workflow targets npm at the root while the code is a pnpm workspace in js/ (js/.nvmrc exists).

title: config: DirectiveDelegator typing and defaults
description: From plans/scope.md: handlers must hand-roll { scope, ctx }; register() casts to DirectiveHandler<TContext, unknown>; _enterScope/_exitScope are public-internal; no async handlers; hooks cannot emit diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: Children walked by default; typed discriminated handler result (children / childrenWith / skip) with no unknown casts; async handlers supported; handlers can report diagnostics; plans/scope.md deleted.

title: config: located diagnostics and consumer reporting
description: All include diagnostics use syntheticSpan() (line 0, col 0) though the include directive is at hand (src/parse.ts). W3005 IncludeNoMatches is defined but never emitted (empty match reports E3001). Consumers invent their own error type (engine IRaslConfigError) because there is no report helper.
acceptance_criteria: Include diagnostics carry the include directive's span; W3005 emitted for empty glob matches; a report(directive, message, code?) helper produces IDiagnostic for consumers.

title: config: typed argument values in core
description: Arguments are flat tokens. The spec (plans/nextgen.md) defines bracket lists and postfix slices, but every consumer re-parses them: engine rasl.ts has coerceScalar and parseSliceTokens.
acceptance_criteria: Each directive argument exposes a typed value (word, string, number, list, slice) per the language spec, with spans; engine coerceScalar/parseSliceTokens are deletable.

title: config: include-transparent directive view
description: Includes are resolved into a document graph, but there is no view that walks them in place. iterateDirectives (src/iterate.ts) flattens bodies into one stream, losing block nesting despite its doc comment. 'include' is hard-coded in parse.ts and iterate.ts. The engine loader (engine/src/config/rasl.ts) walks only graph.root, so nodes in included files are silently ignored.
acceptance_criteria: An AST view replaces each include with its targets' directives in place, preserving nesting; include handling is a registered directive, not a hard-coded name; the engine reads nodes from included files (test proves it).

title: Add WebSocket external:update protocol
description: Add server WebSocket handling for graphId/nodeId addressed normalized vector updates to externally writable source nodes.
acceptance_criteria: Valid external:update returns external:ack; malformed payload, unknown graph/node, non-external node, invalid value, and length mismatch return stable error codes without changing held state.

title: JS operational external source implementation
description: Make js dev:server operational, add WebSocket-driven ExternalSource with normalized 0..1 vectors, and preserve graph-level scene logic.
acceptance_criteria: npm run dev:server -- <config> starts from TS source; ExternalSource accepts WebSocket external:update values; graph can route values into SacnSink; tests cover config, node, websocket, and E1.31 packet path.

title: Validate E1.31 output path from ExternalSource
description: Ensure normalized ExternalSource matrix values can route to SacnSink and produce expected DMX bytes.
acceptance_criteria: Local UDP receiver test observes expected E1.31 packet bytes for values sent over WebSocket.

title: Port canonical Python runtime pieces into JS source
description: Align JS engine source with canonical Python graph/runtime concepts where JS files are missing or stale, including monitor/routing support and current exports.
acceptance_criteria: @rasl/engine typecheck passes and fresh dist exports current source APIs without legacy graph/log/runtime path drift.

title: config: keep or drop ANTLR4 parser generator
description: plans/nextgen.md commits to ANTLR4 for cross-language ports. It adds a runtime dependency and complicates trivia preservation, while the handwritten parser already round-trips byte-identically. Recommendation: drop it; use the spec plus conformance corpus (packaging epic) for ports.
acceptance_criteria: Owner decides; the outcome is recorded here and plans/nextgen.md updated or deleted.

title: engine: move config loader onto @rasl/config layers
description: engine/src/config/rasl.ts (401 lines) bypasses the AST facade and delegator, reads raw CST tokens, hand-rolls coercion, slices and error locations, and ignores includes.
acceptance_criteria: rasl.ts uses the include view, typed values and declarative definitions; its private coercion, slice parsing and IRaslConfigError are removed; existing engine config tests pass plus a test for nodes in included files.

title: config: declarative directive definitions
description: The 'minimal integration' tier marked TBD in plans/nextgen.md. Users should declare a directive's name, argument types and allowed children and get typed results plus located diagnostics. Prior art: schema libraries; accept any Standard Schema validator rather than bundling one.
acceptance_criteria: A user defines directives declaratively and receives typed output and located diagnostics; works with a Standard Schema validator (e.g. zod) in a test; built on the typed values, diagnostics and delegator epics.

title: config: open-source packaging and spec
description: plans/nextgen.md milestone 0 and API hygiene: RASL-centric name/README/fixtures; parseDocument (sync single-file) not exported so the simplest use needs async parse plus a dummy loader; public types mutable; no published grammar. Interface naming follows js/STYLE.md 3.6 (I prefix kept).
acceptance_criteria: RASL removed from package surface; a sync single-file parse entry point exported; public types readonly; grammar plus conformance corpus published as the spec.

title: config: AST editing API with token splicing
description: README claims AST edits modify the CST, but IAstDirective has no mutators and the token-splice utilities in plans/roundtrip.md do not exist, so save() has nothing to persist. No consumer needs editing yet; fix the README claim now.
acceptance_criteria: rename, setArgs, insert and remove edit tokens in place preserving formatting; golden tests show only intended token ranges change; save() persists edits across included files; plans/roundtrip.md deleted.
